contract: ../forecast-search-usability.md and ../../design.MD: approved Forecasts search and compact evidence contract; actual local production app with synthetic fixtures only.

accessibility.evidence: Production Chromium checks exercise keyboard suggestion selection, ordinary Tab dismissal and next-control focus, Escape, clear/focus behavior, keyboard disclosure toggling, labels, visible focus and 44px standalone mobile summary targets. Real screen-reader testing was not performed.

responsive.evidence: Both English and real Arabic locales were captured at laptop and mobile viewports; both quality surfaces were also checked at 768/800px. Assertions verify no document overflow, input bounds, the tablet header height and mobile input size. Tables retain local horizontal scrolling.

loading.evidence: A held lookup request visibly shows Searching locations; a later request wins and stale responses cannot replace its suggestions.

empty.evidence: Active-only lookup for an inactive location yields a visible no-match explanation and manual-code recovery; filtered quality no-match feedback is verified for a branch-restricted location.

error.evidence: An intercepted 500 lookup displays localized recovery text while preserving the typed manual code. A later request recovers successfully.

partial.evidence: The existing planning KPI browser regression verifies unavailable saved quality scores remain an em dash, while populated exact scores and independent coverage evidence remain visible.

success.evidence: Production checks apply quality search, advanced filters, chips, reset, display controls and paging, preserve exact decimal scores, and restore a single quality form through browser Back/Forward.

permission.evidence: Actual local sessions verify anonymous lookup denial, foreign-tenant exclusion, branch-only suggestions and branch-restricted saved-quality visibility. Unit tests also verify missing-active-organization denial and no-store responses.

limitations: Chromium only; no Firefox/Safari or physical-device certification.
Full-page images can be taller than their browser viewport.
No perceptual similarity percentage or test coverage percentage was collected.
